On L2 you can send a robot to 4 locations:

- `lift_lobby_L2` - lift lobby area
- `pick_l2_1` - pickup point 1
- `pick_l2_2` - pickup point 2  
- `charger_l2` - charging station (has charger)

All are on level L2. The charger location is the only one with a charger. Which type of destination do you need?
